messages:
Liam H (AE): Quick ask — Prospect Meridian wants a compact assurance packet (SOC2 excerpt, ISO cert, signed pen-test attestation) before their procurement completes POC purchase. Also asked whether Dedicated changes pricing and lead time. Need a one-paragraph reply by EOD.

Priya N (Solutions): I can assemble the pack. Typical minimal bundle I hand out: ```- SOC2 Type II executive summary (pdf)
- ISO27001 certificate (pdf)
- Pen-test attestation (one-page, signed)
- Short ops note: Dedicated cost/ETA + staging scan window
- Presigned upload README```

Joan K (Security): We have a pen-test attestation template. We need the customer's legal "TO:" line to populate and they must ACK our template. We redact internal IPs/complete logs. Turnaround: signed within 48 hours once recipient confirmed.

Sam R (Legal): Legal will sign the attestation as "Redwood Inference, Inc. ile: Legal Counsel (on behalf of Security)". Need recipient legal entity and confirmation they accept our template. I can sign within 48 hours after that.

Hector M (Infra): Dedicated quick note: baseline small pool (2x A10G-equivalent) uplift ~$7,000/mo, one-time setup ~$3,500. Provisioning ETA ~5 business days after PO. If they want private KMS (customer-managed), add one-time integration ~$4k and +$1k/mo. We prefer an external scan window Tue 09:00-13:00 UTC.

Liam H (AE): Can someone drop the draft files in a read-only dataroom link I can send now? I'll ask Meridian for the TO: line and whether they want Dedicated + CMK.

DataroomBot: Assurance dataroom created: https://dataroom.redwood/assurance/MERIDIAN-5802469136 (view-only). Uploaded: soc2-exec-summary.pdf, iso27001-cert.pdf, pen-test-template.docx (unsigned), dedicated-uplift-note.txt, presigned-readme.md

Priya N (Solutions): Uploaded a short README and a checklist. Will redact any sensitive fields in SOC2 excerpt.

Joan K (Security): Confirming: we'll sign the pen-test attestation within ~48 hours after Meridian provides the recipient TO: line and accepts template.

Sam R (Legal): I'll prep the signed letter once they confirm recipient name and acceptance.

Hector M (Infra): Reiterating costs/ETAs above. If they stay hosted, no uplift/ETA needed.

Liam H (AE): Great — I'll send the dataroom link and ask Meridian to confirm TO: and Dedicated intent. Will update thread when they reply. :thumbsup:

Meridian (reply expected): "Thanks, we'll confirm TO: and Dedicated decision by tomorrow morning."
